speak.title: Role-play: your snoring or my sleep
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You have lain awake for weeks because of your partner's snoring. You want to try separate rooms. Explain how tired you are, but do not hurt your partner's feelings.

b.text: You feel hurt that your partner wants a separate room. Say how you feel and suggest other ideas first, such as earplugs or different bedtimes. Agree to something if the plan is fair.

phrases: I'm exhausted, and I can't go on like this.
It doesn't mean I love you any less.
Let's try it for a month and see.
I'd feel lonely without you next to me.
We're not ending anything, we're just sleeping better.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree on a plan, and was it fair for both people?
